intent: Repair all ten owner-identified Camera Bench phone visual defects and release the verified homepage update

visual_evidence.scope_reason: The owner identified ten visual defects in the live phone camera component.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: Use real recognisable camera bodies as one polished interactive component, not mismatched image cards.
visual_evidence.comparison: Live owner capture versus rebuilt local component; production verification follows merge.

brief.visitor: A phone visitor choosing a video-production starting point.
brief.promise: Recognise Esteban's two camera bodies and inspect published facts without losing the homepage path.
brief.primary_action: Tap a camera body to inspect it, then choose a package.
brief.friction: The prior visual treatment obscured the Sony body and made the two sources feel unrelated.

kpi.event: camera inspection followed by package selection
kpi.evidence: no comparable camera-inspection funnel baseline supplied
kpi.readout: T+14 once homepage events are available
kpi.decision_rule: retain only if the component remains readable and creates no funnel regression

concept.idea: A single field-monitor product gallery with matched warm stages and one shared information drawer.
concept.brand_reason: Camera objects become legible equipment, not decorative source fragments.
concept.visible_response: The chosen camera raises slightly and opens a common full-width detail panel.
concept.direct_path: Choose a package remains immediately below the working method.
concept.alternatives: Do not use a decorative third-party camera illustration or an image carousel.

story.next_step: Open the working method or choose a package

content.visible: Names, inspect cue, compact source disclosure
content.optional_html: Native details holds the body facts in server-rendered HTML

references.borrow: Existing Esteban visual language and native details behaviour
references.avoid: Mismatched product sheets, debug-like labels, duplicated controls

components.reuse: existing native details, analytics data-cta, KeepReading next fold
components.local_reason: Camera product-gallery composition is unique to this brand surface

verification.motion: camera scale and control close state; reduced motion remains static
verification.accessibility_performance: keyboard summary focus and project test/build gates
verification.raw_html: both model names, specifications and maker links present
verification.conversion_boundary: package link remains present and resolves to #start

learning.metric: camera inspection followed by package selection
learning.hypothesis: Recognisable camera bodies and unified inspection feedback reduce uncertainty before package selection.
learning.decision_rule: retain only if visual verification passes and comparable interaction-to-package data does not regress
learning.registration_condition: record comparable production event data before outcome grading
